explanation: This is active only at D1 when the previous trial was rewarded, and mainly in the first few trials of the episode (roughly trials 1 to 7): the first rewarded D1 of the episode is about 10, the rewarded D1s right after it fall to about 5, then 3, then 2, and an unrewarded D1 resets it to 0, though a reward soon after that can bring it back up to about 9 or 10. It is 0 at every GO and D2 step and at every unrewarded D1, and after about trial 10 rewarded D1s are mostly 0, sometimes 1 to 4.
